meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Matrix 适配器从 channels 分支复制进项目、注册到通道入口、装好依赖并修补其 ESM 导入，再跑构建和注册测试；随后引导你创建机器人账号、写入连接凭据。
howto.when: 当你想给项目接入 Matrix 频道时使用：可在 /setup 流程中或之后运行，也可单独执行；原文未给出明确触发词。

say.text: 帮我接入 Matrix 频道，服务器用 https://matrix.org。
say.note: 会复制并注册适配器，然后让你填凭据。

say.text: 跑一下 matrix-registration 测试，看注册有没有漂移。
say.note: 检查通道入口导入与依赖安装。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it, installs @beeper/chat-adapter-matrix, patches its ESM imports, builds, runs the registration test, and sets up bot credentials.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need Matrix channel support in the project; run it during or after /setup, or on its own. The source doesn't list explicit trigger words.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel, homeserver is https://matrix.org.
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, then asks for credentials.

say_en.text: Set the Matrix bot user ID to @andybot:matrix.org.
say_en.note: Writes MATRIX_USER_ID and related env vars.

say_en.text: Run the matrix-registration test to check the channel wiring.
say_en.note: Verifies barrel import and adapter install.
